title: pthread_mutex_init() return value not checked
description:
On POSIX (line 215), pthread_mutex_init() return value is ignored. This can fail with ENOMEM or EAGAIN under resource exhaustion. If initialization fails silently, the mutex is left in an undefined state and subsequent lock/unlock operations have undefined behavior.

File: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/tx_queue.c
Line: 215
